description: THE SWEEP'S RUNNING COUNT — use this while executing SWEEP.md instead of counting in your head. Report every message you read, in batches, each with its message_id and exactly one bucket: matched (include the entry; it is written to the tab for you, deduped on the message id), unmatched_transactional (include amount, currency and sender — a bare amount is refused, never stamped USD), or not_transactional. Refused verdicts are returned with reasons and NOT counted — fix and resubmit them, never drop them. Duplicates are counted once. There is no fourth bucket on purpose.

messages.description: one verdict per message read, up to 200 per call

amount.description: unmatched_transactional only: the money the letter carried

bucket.description: exactly one of the three; there is no fourth

currency.description: unmatched_transactional only: ISO 4217 code as the letter carried it — required; the tally will not assume USD

entry.description: matched only: closed vocabulary, numbers, dates. problem_solved, captured_text and notes are refused — the tab writes '(not said yet)' itself.

confidence.description: stated when the letter says it; inferred when you worked it out

event.description: which lifecycle moment the letter reports

occurred_at.description: the letter's date — recorded as a retroactive claim

price.description: the STATED amount and period — the annual/monthly slip is a 12x error

trial_ends.description: ISO date the trial converts, if the letter says

message_id.description: the letter's own id — the dedupe key

source.description: historical_pass on the six-month backward run; mail_sweep forward

sweep_id.description: your name for this sweep, same on every batch (e.g. sweep_2026-08)

name: sweep_tally
title: Sweep Tally
